The templates of Angular's control-flow guide, adev/src/content/guide/templates/control-flow.md at
the tag v22.2.3 (REF-ANGULAR-CONTROL-FLOW), copied as they are: each angular-html block, and the
template literal of each angular-ts block. Read by tools/lint/src/template/corpus.rs.

@@@ template 1 @if
@if (a > b) {
  <p>{{ a }} is greater than {{ b }}</p>
}
@@@ template 2 @else if and @else
@if (a > b) {
  {{ a }} is greater than {{ b }}
} @else if (b > a) {
  {{ a }} is less than {{ b }}
} @else {
  {{ a }} is equal to {{ b }}
}
@@@ template 3 the conditional expression's result
@if (user.profile.settings.startDate; as startDate) {
  {{ startDate }}
}
@@@ template 4 @for
@for (item of items; track item.id) {
  {{ item.name }}
}
@@@ template 5 track
@for (item of items; track item) {
  {{ item.name }}
}
@@@ template 6 contextual variables
@for (item of items; track item.id; let idx = $index, e = $even) {
  <p>Item #{{ idx }}: {{ item.name }}</p>
}
@@@ template 7 @empty
@for (item of items; track item.name) {
  <li>{{ item.name }}</li>
} @empty {
  <li>There are no items.</li>
}
@@@ template 8 @switch
@switch (userPermissions) {
  @case ('admin') {
    <app-admin-dashboard />
  }
  @case ('reviewer')
  @case ('editor') {
    <app-editor-dashboard />
  }
  @default {
    <app-viewer-dashboard />
  }
}
@@@ template 9 exhaustive type checking
    @switch (state) {
      @case ('loggedOut') {
        <button>Login</button>
      }

      @case ('loggedIn') {
        <p>Welcome back!</p>
      }

      @default never;
      <!-- throws because @case ('loading') is missing -->
    }

@@@ template 10 exhaustive type checking of a nested expression
    @switch (state.mode) {
      @case ('show') {
        {{ state.menu }};
      }
      @case ('hide') {}
      @default never(state);
    }
